contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report): 23,600.00', which equals the cover's 'Totals for This Report' line-1 cell (23,600.00)
contributions.detail: 11 Form A rows: 5,000.00 + 5,000.00 + 5,000.00 + 1,500.00 + 500.00 + 100.00 + 500.00 + 5,000.00 + [dash] + [dash] + 1,000.00 = 23,600.00 = the schedule's own printed total = the cover's This-Report line-1 cell. Cumulative is 31,415.05 over a Totals-from-Last-Report of 7,815.05 (exactly this filer's 2018 final cumulative balance — an officeholder account carried across cycles), and that 7,815.05 is NOT itemized anywhere on this document, so the schedule is period-scoped behind a cumulative cover. Rows 9 and 10 are in-kind items whose Amount cell holds a BARE DASH; per the zero-glyph ruling a dash is a nil mark, not a numeral, so both amounts are BLANK with needs_review set — and the filer's own printed total treats them as contributing nothing, which is what makes 23,600.00 close on the nine valued rows. 2022 is the 3-line form variant (a single 'contributions from all donors' cell, no separate <=$50 aggregate line), so the whole published This-Report contributions figure is anchored here.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report): 22,519.87', which equals the cover's This-Report AND Cumulative line-2 cells (both 22,519.87)
expenditures.detail: 9 Form B rows: 235.00 + 2,000.00 + 12,193.71 + 750.00 + 3,300.00 + 18.31 + 2,500.00 + 702.60 + 820.25 = 22,519.87 = the schedule's own printed total. The cover's Totals-from-Last-Report expenditures cell is BLANK, so This Report == Cumulative and the expenditure side is a whole-account list, not a period slice. Line 3 closes independently: 7,815.05 + 23,600.00 - 22,519.87 = 8,895.18, the printed cumulative ending balance, and 23,600.00 - 22,519.87 = 1,080.13, the printed This-Report balance.

itemized.escalation_note: 16 tight crops, all GEOMETRY proofs or orientation determination rather than glyph re-reads (both schedules are typed and read cleanly at full page). Two 400 dpi full-width strips of p41 (top and bottom 12%) established the ROTATION: this is a landscape sheet rendered portrait, the Date column lies along the TOP of the rendered page and the Amount column along the BOTTOM, and the data rows advance RIGHT-TO-LEFT. Fourteen 900 dpi --value crops of amount cells then fixed the row indexing on both sheets: on p41 the first probe at band [85.65,88.74] returned the word 'Amount' (the header) and [82.53,85.65] returned the printed GRAY DOTTED SPACER, which is what caught a two-band off-by-one before it was recorded; row 1 was then confirmed at [79.44,82.53] = 5,000.00, with rows 7/8/9/10/11 confirmed as 500.00 / 5,000.00 / dash / dash / 1,000.00. The same probe sequence on p42 found header at [83.26,85.56], spacer at [80.26,83.26], row 1 = 235.00 at [77.41,80.26], and confirmed rows 3 (12,193.71), 9 (820.25) and the first empty band (10).

itemized.notes: Gage Froerer, 'Weber County Commission Seat A', 2022 cycle, the 'June 14 - 21' primary report box ticked, signed by both the candidate and the committee secretary on June 21, 2022. This is the AMENDED copy — the word 'Amended' is HANDWRITTEN across the top of the cover in the same hand that signed it, and the portal label is 'Primary - Amended'. Per the brief it is transcribed ON ITS OWN TERMS as a separate document: nothing here is merged with, or read as a correction of, its 2022 original twin, and a cycle rollup must not add the two together. It is in turn superseded for cycle-total purposes by Froerer's 2022-11-01 report (already noted in the stated-totals cache). Page order IS form order: cover p40, Form A p41, Form B p42. BOTH SCHEDULES ARE ROTATED LANDSCAPE SHEETS rendered portrait, with the Date column along the top of the rendered page, the Amount column along the bottom, and the data rows advancing RIGHT-TO-LEFT; the row lists above are in printed order (row 1 = the rightmost band). Everything is typed, not handwritten. The two sides have DIFFERENT SCOPES on the same document and the cover says so: contributions are period-only over a 7,815.05 officeholder carry-forward, while expenditures have a blank Last-Report cell so This Report == Cumulative. Two contribution rows carry a bare dash where an amount belongs and are recorded as BLANK, not zero (zero-glyph ruling) — the contributions side is therefore a complete list of the period's ENTRIES but its dollar figure counts only the nine valued rows, exactly as the filer's own total does. Dates on Form A run back to 4/5/2021 and on Form B to 5/20/2021, well before the June 2022 report window, confirming the filer treated 'This Report' as everything since the last report filed. The candidate's street address and cell number print on the cover and are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md); the county applied no redaction to this 2022 archive copy.
